description: Pick & ship on a phone: today's work for the yard (Next's picking queue, in sections by the day it must ship, late first) as cards with a ring of how many pieces are picked; the yard (several: chosen once, remembered on this phone); search. A request opens on its pieces as a big checklist in walking order, by step (release, being picked, waiting for Fusion, shipped), with the next piece to fetch; ticked by tap, by scanning its tag or by typing its unit number. Release (fixed assets), Pick and ship and the pick slip are Next's chains, with the same calls, order and guards; each says what will happen in a sheet first. Read-only looks. With no connection: the copy saved on this phone, ticks kept as picked, not yet sent, and nothing is sent.

saved.description: When the list shown is this phone's copy (no connection): when it was saved, in words.

records.description: The picking queue (yardWork.queueRows of views/workbench-requests?stage=INITIATE), as Next's.

linesBy.description: { requestId: views/request-detail-lines rows | null when they could not be loaded }.

yards.description: { lineId: yard | '' } from views/line-detail-units, filled in after the list shows (Next's lookups).

units.description: { lineId: [unit numbers] } from the same answers: a unit scanned on the list finds its request.

yard.description: The yard this person works from ('all' for every yard), remembered on this phone.

yardKnown.description: The remembered yard has been read from the phone.

items.description: yardWork.items('picking', …): each request with its pieces.

pending.description: Requests with pieces ticked with no connection, kept on this phone, not yet sent.

can.description: act: EQR_INITIATE_PICKING FULL; slip: SHIPPING_DOCUMENTS_ENABLED; sync: MAINT_ASSET_LOCATION_SYNC_ENABLED.

listY.description: Where the list was scrolled to when a request opened.

work.description: The open request's picking workspace (Next's openWorkChain).

workSaved.description: When the open request is this phone's copy: when it was saved, in words. Steps then need a fresh read.

ticks.description: Ticked line ids (Next's ticks): picked pieces, and fixed assets to release.

selectedTOId.description: The single ticked transfer order, or '' (yardWork.selectedTOIdFor).

check.description: mobilePick.checklist: the pick list as shown.

sheet.description: '' | ship | release | scan | yard | slip: the bottom sheet open.

sheetData.description: What the Ship or Release sheet says (mobilePick.shipSheet, releaseSheet).

flash.description: The piece last scanned, shown lit in the list.

focusRequest.description: Another tab or a deep link asked to show a request here (mobileBus.focus('pick', …)).

connection.description: The phone went online or offline (window online / offline).

hidden.description: The page was hidden (the phone locked, another app): the camera stops.
